mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM vi_order o JOIN vi_payment_order p ON p.order_id = o.id AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' WHERE o.fulfillment_status = 'SCHEDULED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vi_outbox e WHERE e.event_key = CONCAT('DISPATCH_TIMER:', o.id) OR e.event_key = CONCAT('DISPATCH_PLAN_MISSING:', o.id) ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_station s JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id WHERE s.id = #{stationId} AND s.dept_id = #{deptId} AND s.enabled = 1 AND d.status = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.quota_type) FROM vi_quota_reservation r JOIN vi_quota_slot s ON s.id = r.slot_id JOIN vi_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND s.station_id = o.station_id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.quantity = 1 AND s.quota_type IN ('PICKUP', 'STATION_RECEIVE')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_payment_order p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.payment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING','UNKNOWN','ABNORMAL') THEN r.amount_fen ELSE 0 END) AS approved_reserved, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status='SUCCESS' THEN r.amount_fen ELSE 0 END) AS approved_refunded FROM vi_refund_order r JOIN vi_aftersale_case c ON c.id=r.case_id AND c.payment_id=r.payment_id JOIN vi_aftersale_review v ON v.case_id=c.id AND v.revision=r.review_revision WHERE c.order_id=#{orderId} AND c.kind='REFUND_ONLY' AND c.review_status='APPROVED' AND c.case_status IN ('EXECUTING','CLOSED') AND c.return_state='NOT_REQUIRED' AND c.review_revision=r.review_revision AND v.decision='APPROVE' AND v.return_required=0 AND r.amount_fen>0 AND r.amount_fen=c.approved_fen AND r.amount_fen=v.approved_fen GROUP BY r.payment_id ) approved ON approved.payment_id=p.id WHERE p.order_id=#{orderId} AND (p.refund_reserved_fen<>COALESCE(approved.approved_reserved,0) OR p.refunded_fen<>COALESCE(approved.approved_refunded,0))
SELECT items_json FROM vi_quote WHERE id = #{quoteId}
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_order SET fulfillment_status = #{state}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND fulfillment_status = 'SCHEDULED' AND cancel_status = 'NONE' AND active_assignment_id IS NULL
